checks: The water field guide opens a close view of the measured jug and empty pot without filling or advancing time.
A level carry and a cancelled tipped jug return all preview water, with no food, heat or time changes.
Wrong cookware and sideways tipping do not fill the pasta pot.
The real release location is checked again so a previously ready tip cannot fill after moving away.
After a jug fill, its stale keyboard launch follows the current water task instead of offering to refill and cool warmed water.
A completed jug carry fills the exact two-serving recipe measure once, stays cool until heated and restores on reload.
Grabbing the jug from another cooking mode selects Move while keeping the camera and canvas steady.
Filled, heated, cooking and drained pots reject another jug transfer without replacing water or resetting temperature.
The jug route opens and focuses the equivalent keyboard fill action without performing it automatically.
The sauce quest progresses through a real jug fill, burner controls and the recorded tray handoff while tool launches alone create no cooking evidence.
A checked pasta batch routes to native pot-and-colander draining and retains its equivalent keyboard hold control.
A ready sauce quest opens the drained-pasta colander handoff and focuses its correct keyboard combine equivalent.
Missing garlic routes to mincing, then its actual bowl and keyboard transfer before the quest offers combining.
Real phone pickup, carry, tip and release fills the exact four-serving mushroom water measure.
Real phone pickup, carry, tip and release fills the exact four-serving tomato water measure.
Touch cancellation, blur, external cooking changes and resize return fresh water without a stray fill action.
The water guide and interaction fit compact screens and pass desktop, phone and forced-color accessibility scans.
Finished and replay cooks allow observation while fresh-water transfers stay locked.
Graphics-context loss returns the preview jug and leaves pot filling usable through existing controls.

accessibility.name: Desktop measured water and field guide
